purpose: Read-only installed primary-source contract preparation, not E06 implementation/build/network/optimization proof

iconContracts.modelMatching: First modelMappings entry whose case-insensitive regex keyword matches lowercased model; order is observable. Preserve mapping props then caller rest precedence.
iconContracts.providerMatching: First providerMappings case-insensitive exact keyword equality; mapping props then caller rest precedence. Provider mono LobeHub exact original enum special case when !forceMono.
iconContracts.fallback: Actual ModelIcon DefaultIcon uses LobeUI Icon/Brain and antd description color; ProviderIcon DefaultIcon uses LobeUI ProviderIcon symbol. Existing shapes and prop/color/size forwarding differ by type. Known brand Color/Combine/Brand/Text fallbacks are ordered. Do not replace all unknown and known brands with a single approximate glyph.
iconContracts.packageSurface: Icons5.18.0 has no exports map, publishes es/ with per-brand entries/types. Physical subpath availability is observed, not a documented long-term public guarantee or final implementation choice. Any optimized source must pin/test mapping fidelity and actual build/type availability.

richRendererContracts.observed: Installed LobeUI useHighlight declares shikiModulePromise=loadShikiModule() at module evaluation; loadShikiModule imports shiki in browser. CodeBlock is statically imported by useMarkdownComponents. Existing dynamic import does not by itself establish fenced-only demand loading.
richRendererContracts.limits: Only module/source observation. Actual emitted module/network edges and scenario byte impact must be measured with fresh four actual production scenarios after E05 acceptance. No vendor patch/renderer replacement chosen.
